1.

Thou art great, our God and Father, In Thy love’s power, In the eternal atonement, Which the Son hath accomplished.

C.

Holy, holy, holy is Thy name; A sacrifice of praise unto Thine honour May we bring forth.

2.

Christ, Thou our salvation’s Captain, Thine are we, And Thou art our life, our Head, Thus shall it be eternally.

3.

Unto Thy wondrous name May we gather here, Teach us to know what the precious Name doth signify.

4.

Through grace may we now behold Thy glory, Into the sanctuary to enter With boldness.
